title: ADR-003: Terminate TLS at the gateway
body: Every public request terminates TLS at the gateway. Service-to-service calls use mTLS certificates issued by the platform team.

title: ADR-004: Short-lived access tokens
body: Access tokens expire after 15 minutes. Clients refresh with a 30-day refresh token bound to the device.

title: ADR-005: Feature flags in config-svc
body: Feature flags live in config-svc. Every service caches flags locally for 30 seconds, so config-svc is on the startup path of almost every service.

title: ADR-006: Nightly warehouse batch
body: Events are exported to the warehouse once a night. Reports are a day stale.

title: ADR-008: Cart state in redis
body: Carts live in redis-cache and expire after 7 days of inactivity.

title: ADR-009: Idempotency keys on every payout write
body: Context: on Black Friday 2025 (INC-007) a change that skipped the dedupe check on the payout batch path produced 312 duplicate payouts. Decision: every write to the ledger payout table carries an idempotency key per payout request, enforced in the ledger, not the caller. Rejected: removing the dedupe check to cut write latency; deduping only in the client, because retries from mobile bypass it. Owners: Dana Okafor, Omar Haddad.

title: ADR-010: Rules engine owns hand-written rules
body: Risk analysts edit rules in rules-engine. fraud-svc combines the rule verdict with the model score.

title: ADR-011: KYC documents in object storage
body: Identity documents are written to s3-docs with per-customer keys. Access is logged.

title: ADR-012: Mobile backend-for-frontend
body: The apps call mobile-bff, which aggregates checkout-api and auth-svc responses into screen-sized payloads.

title: ADR-013: Email through a single sender
body: email-svc is the only sender. Notifications hands it templated jobs over the event bus.

title: ADR-014: Event bus on kafka
body: Producers publish to event-bus topics. Consumers can replay up to 7 days.

title: ADR-015: Support refunds go through support-api
body: admin-console calls support-api, which calls payments-api and ledger. Every refund is audited.

title: ADR-016: Referral rewards capped per user
body: Each user can earn at most 10 referral rewards a month.

title: ADR-017: Synchronous payment chain with inline risk check
body: Context: chargebacks rose 40% in Q4 2025. Decision: checkout-api calls payments-api synchronously, and payments-api calls fraud-svc inline before capture, so fraudulent payments are blocked before money moves. Consequence: payments-api latency now includes fraud-svc latency; checkout availability depends on fraud-svc. Proposed by Priya Raman in #payments-arch on 2026-01-22. Deciders: Priya Raman, Dana Okafor.

title: ADR-018: Gateway rate limits per merchant
body: The gateway enforces request budgets per merchant API key.

title: ADR-019: Feature store snapshots for training
body: Daily snapshots of ml-features are kept for 18 months for training and audits.

title: ADR-020: Payout batches every 15 minutes
body: Payouts are batched every 15 minutes. Each batch writes to the ledger with idempotency keys (see ADR-009).

title: ADR-021: Session storage in redis
body: Sessions are stored in redis-cache so they can be revoked instantly.

title: ADR-022: Streaming warehouse ingestion
body: Supersedes ADR-006. warehouse-sync consumes event-bus and lands events within 5 minutes.

title: ADR-023: Push notification quiet hours
body: Transactional pushes are always sent; marketing pushes respect quiet hours.

title: ADR-024: Checkout web server-side rendering
body: Checkout pages are server-rendered; the payment form hydrates on the client.

title: ADR-025: Admin console single sign-on
body: Support agents sign in with SSO and a hardware key.

title: ADR-026: Reporting API read replica
body: Reports query a pg-main read replica, because heavy reports once slowed writes on the shared primary.

title: ADR-027: Cart merges on login
body: When a guest logs in, their guest cart is merged into their saved cart.

title: payments-api error code conventions
body: payments-api returns errors as PAY-xxxx codes with a retryable flag. Clients should map PAY-1001 to "card declined". This RFC is about error formats only.

title: Postmortem: INC-007 duplicate payouts
body: On 2025-11-28 a change removed the dedupe check on the payout batch path to cut write latency. 312 merchants were paid twice. Dana Okafor led the response. Follow-up: ADR-009.

title: Runbook: checkout-api
body: Owner Aisha Bello. checkout-api depends on payments-api, cart and auth-svc.

title: Runbook: ledger
body: Owner Omar Haddad. Never bypass idempotency keys. Reconciliation job runs hourly.

title: Runbook: payments-api
body: Owner: Priya Raman (payments). Escalation: payments on-call. payments-api calls fraud-svc and ledger synchronously; if fraud-svc is slow, payments-api latency rises with it.
